findings: Side EWA view shows low orange body under gold light, climb in gap and high magenta body above retained tabletop.
Oblique/high EWA views retain nearby wall occlusion; do not use them alone to infer clearance.
Ground EWA overview is heavily ceiling-occluded (yellow supports); route outline agrees with JSON but obstacle proximity is not readable there.
3D thinned context and profiles show supported cylinder detour, reduced aggregate turning and matching straight sweeper route; they do not authorize collision safety.
UAV retains two stopped geometric corners at protected climb joins; smoothing improves total turning and time derivatives, not everywhere geometric curvature.
limitations: Raw EWA paths and final smoothed context are distinct products; no physical controller execution or photorealistic final flight video is claimed.
